tools.name: anyhook_mock
tools.description: Generate a webhook request with a valid signature for Stripe, GitHub, or Slack. If targetUrl is provided, the request is POSTed there and the response is returned.

tools.name: anyhook_verify
tools.description: Verify a webhook signature against a secret. Supports 19 providers including stripe, github, shopify, slack, discord, linear, vercel, paddle, hubspot, and paypal.

tools.name: anyhook_providers
tools.description: List webhook providers AnyHook can mock, along with the event types available for each.

tools.name: anyhook_quickstart
tools.description: Zero-config bootstrap: creates a free ephemeral relay endpoint + API key with no signup. Returns inbound_url (receives webhooks immediately), api_key, and claim_url. This MCP session auto-connects to the new account; remote tools work right after. Endpoint expires in 7 days unless claimed.

tools.name: anyhook_apps_list
tools.description: List apps in your AnyHook account with inbound URLs, sources, and destination URLs.

tools.name: anyhook_inbox
tools.description: Every AnyHook app is also an email inbox: mail sent to {user}.{app}@anyhook.net becomes an event (type email.received) you can read with anyhook_events. Returns the address and webhook URL for one of your apps. No account yet? anyhook_quickstart returns an inbox_address directly.

tools.name: anyhook_apps_create
tools.description: Create a new app with a name, provider source, and (optionally) destinations. Returns the inbound URL.

tools.name: anyhook_replay
tools.description: Re-send a stored event to its destinations. Replay does NOT consume monthly event quota — safe to call repeatedly while debugging.

tools.name: anyhook_undelivered
tools.description: Show events for the given app that have not successfully reached any destination (failed or still retrying).

tools.name: anyhook_replay_failed
tools.description: Re-send every failed event for the given app slug. Useful after fixing a downstream bug to recover queued work.

tools.name: anyhook_events
tools.description: List webhook events (most recent first). Uses your AnyHook account when connected (via ANYHOOK_API_KEY or anyhook_quickstart), otherwise the local in-memory store.

tools.name: anyhook_inspect
tools.description: Full detail for one event: source, type, status, delivery summary. Account or local store.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: anyhook_apps_list, anyhook_inbox · Private data: anyhook_verify, anyhook_quickstart · Public sink: anyhook_mock, anyhook_verify, anyhook_providers, anyhook_inbox, anyhook_replay, anyhook_replay_failed, anyhook_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: anyhook_apps_list, anyhook_inbox · Private data: anyhook_verify, anyhook_quickstart · Public sink: anyhook_mock, anyhook_verify, anyhook_providers, anyhook_inbox, anyhook_replay, anyhook_replay_failed, anyhook_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
